title: 雨季の鏡、あるいは渡り鳥の証言
author: 神楽坂 探

en.title: Mirror of the Rainy Season, or the Testimony of a Migratory Bird
en.premise: Following the events of the previous case, a scholar tasked with organizing the Saionji family estate is murdered in a locked room within 'Suikyodo'—a shop that opens only on rainy days. The only clues left behind are an out-of-season migratory bird feather and a reservation book marked with inexplicable times. Ren Kuga sets out to uncover the truth behind the 'temporal locked room' created by the rain.

zh.title: 雨季之镜，或候鸟之证言
zh.premise: 在前作的事件之后，一名负责整理西园寺家遗产的学者，在仅于雨天营业的店铺『水镜堂』的密室中被杀。现场仅留下一根季节外的候鸟羽毛，以及一本记录着不可思议时间的预约簿。久我莲试图揭开由“雨”这一气象条件所构成的“时间性密室”之真相。
